review.notes: Abstract creative observations only. No imported media, identity, or third-party creative direction is retained for rendering.

lessons.principle: A familiar present-day intuition can create a question before a historical, scientific, or conceptual correction answers it.
lessons.application: Use an original hook-to-correction sequence with a world change or visual metaphor.
constraints: Keep factual claims in the reviewed script and local overlays.

lessons.principle: A beat becomes easier to follow when one action or causal relationship is visually dominant.
lessons.application: Give each typed editorial beat one character, prop, route, environmental, or information action.
constraints: Do not turn every noun into a cut.
Do not use a generic text panel instead of an action.

lessons.principle: Hard cuts, recurring cards, and clear visual contrasts can reset attention without adding factual claims.
lessons.application: Use the channel's own page, route, ink, seal, and silhouette transitions at structural narration boundaries.

lessons.principle: Narration-led explainers benefit from a clear voice, restrained music, and selective impact sounds.
lessons.application: Keep narration canonical and add a short sound only when a reviewed on-screen action needs emphasis.
constraints: Do not let provider audio replace canonical narration.
Do not decorate every edit with a sound effect.

lessons.principle: A stable comparison template helps audiences compare distinct subjects without relearning the interface.
lessons.application: Use a small recurring library of local fact folios, item slots, chapter markers, and correction cards.
constraints: Attach information to intentional scene geometry.
Do not obscure the subject with a floating gray box.

observations.signal: Past/present or intuition/reality changes appear on meaningful narration pivots.
observations.design_rule: Make contrast a cut or visible state change, not a paragraph of explanatory type.

observations.signal: The audience can name what moved and why it matters after a beat.
observations.design_rule: Prefer one readable action over several decorative movements.

observations.signal: The scene retains a usable focal plane while foreground elements change.
observations.design_rule: Move characters, props, weather regions, or information—not the entire plate.
